summary: build_arg_defaults sets ANSIBLE_GALAXY_CLI_COLLECTION_OPTS (for example --pre or -c) and ANSIBLE_GALAXY_CLI_ROLE_OPTS (for example --no-deps); values are hard-coded into the Containerfile and a CLI --build-arg overrides them.
